sources.description: Feature plan for REST Controllers & Reactive WebClient
PRD for REST Controllers & Reactive WebClient

tasks.title: Matches REST GET Endpoint
tasks.description: Build the complete vertical slice for retrieving matches by date via REST. Add findByDate(LocalDate date) to CompetitionRepository. Create a MatchRestDTO record with fields: id, teamAName, teamBName, date, time, stadiumName, scoreA, scoreB. Create a @RestController (e.g. CompetitionRestController) with GET /api/matches accepting a @RequestParam date in yyyy-MM-dd format. Map Competition entities to MatchRestDTO. Return 200 with JSON array (empty list if no matches). Return 400 with error JSON for invalid date format. Add /api/** to the public permit-list in the Spring Security configuration so guests, users, and admins can access it without authentication.
acceptance_criteria: CompetitionRepository has a findByDate(LocalDate date) query method
MatchRestDTO record contains id, teamAName, teamBName, date, time, stadiumName, scoreA, scoreB
GET /api/matches?date=2026-05-20 returns 200 with JSON array of matches for that date
GET /api/matches?date=2026-05-20 returns 200 with empty array when no matches exist for that date
GET /api/matches?date=invalid returns 400 with error JSON body
/api/** is added to the public security permit-list
Endpoint is accessible without authentication for guest, user, and admin

tasks.title: Stadium Capacity REST GET Endpoint
tasks.description: Build the complete vertical slice for retrieving stadium capacity by id. Create a StadiumCapacityDTO record with fields: id, name, capacity. Add a GET /api/stadiums/{id}/capacity endpoint (in the existing or a new @RestController) using @PathVariable. Look up the stadium via StadiumRepository.findById. Return 200 with JSON object containing id, name, capacity. Return 404 with { "error": "Stadium not found" } when the stadium id does not exist.
acceptance_criteria: StadiumCapacityDTO record contains id, name, capacity
GET /api/stadiums/1/capacity returns 200 with JSON object for an existing stadium
GET /api/stadiums/999/capacity returns 404 with { "error": "Stadium not found" }
Endpoint is accessible without authentication for guest, user, and admin

tasks.title: Spring WebClient Consumer Service
tasks.description: Add spring-boot-starter-webflux dependency to pom.xml. Create a @Configuration class that defines a WebClient bean with the application's base URL (e.g. http://localhost:8080). Create a service class (e.g. MatchWebClientService) that uses the WebClient bean to call GET /api/matches?date={date} returning Flux<MatchRestDTO> and GET /api/stadiums/{id}/capacity returning Mono<StadiumCapacityDTO>. The service must be injectable and callable as proof that the application consumes its own REST API via Spring Reactive WebClient.
acceptance_criteria: spring-boot-starter-webflux dependency is present in pom.xml
A @Configuration class defines a WebClient bean with the correct base URL
A service class consumes GET /api/matches via WebClient and returns Flux<MatchRestDTO>
The same service consumes GET /api/stadiums/{id}/capacity via WebClient and returns Mono<StadiumCapacityDTO>
The WebClient consumer service is injectable and callable as proof of the WebClient requirement

tasks.title: REST Controller Tests
tasks.description: Write @WebMvcTest tests for both REST endpoints. Use MockMvc and mock the service/repository layer. Cover: happy path for matches endpoint (200 with data), empty list for matches endpoint (200 with []), happy path for stadium capacity (200 with JSON), and 404 for unknown stadium. This fulfills the school-required 'REST controller tests' category.
acceptance_criteria: Test class uses @WebMvcTest targeting the REST controller(s)
Test: GET /api/matches?date=2026-05-20 returns 200 with expected JSON array
Test: GET /api/matches?date=2026-05-20 returns 200 with empty list when no matches exist
Test: GET /api/stadiums/1/capacity returns 200 with expected JSON object
Test: GET /api/stadiums/999/capacity returns 404
Tests use MockMvc with mocked service/repository layers
